1. Local outlier detection methods can be seen as an optimization problem that is solved by a local neighborhood search.
1. The classic distance-based notion of locality is not the only way to define locality.

In summary, our research is concerned with

the following contributions: (1) A theoretical analysis of the properties of local outlier detection methods and the identification of the core of the methods; (2) An extension of the core to a more general framework; (3) The application of our general framework to spatial outlier detection; (4) The comparison and generalization with respect to existing spatial outlier detection methods; and (5) The application to video and network outlier detection, which are special cases of spatial outlier detection.
